fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
Welcome shirts ship in the right size

New hires at Northwind get a welcome kit link with their offer letter. Each picks a size, a classic or relaxed fit, and confirms a shipping address. Nobody pays. Every Monday the fulfillment vendor receives the week's list as a CSV, and the people team gets a Slack message naming anyone who has not answered.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { schoolSpiritWear: "I run the PTO at Lincoln Middle School and we sell spirit shirts: youth sizes at $15 and adult sizes at $18. Build an order form where parents pick a size and quantity, enter the student's homeroom and pay by card. Close it Friday at 3 pm, email Bayside Printing one count per size, and give me a handout list grouped by homeroom.", reunionShirts: "I'm organizing the Delgado family reunion and 41 relatives are coming. Build a shirt order form with navy or heather gray at $20, a size, and an optional name on the back for $5. Everyone pays by card. Out-of-state relatives enter a mailing address and everyone else picks up at the welcome table. Show me both groups in one table.", printShopOrders: "My shop, Inkwell Print Co., prints team shirts. Give each team captain a link for their design where players enter a name and size. Add $3 to every 2XL or larger shirt. Hold any group under 24 shirts and show the captain how many more are needed. When a group reaches 24, email me so I can send the art proof.", newHireKits: "My people team at Northwind sends new hires a welcome kit. Build a form linked from the offer letter where each new hire picks a shirt size, a classic or relaxed fit, and confirms a shipping address. No payment. Every Monday, email our fulfillment vendor the week's list as a CSV and post a Slack message naming anyone who has not answered." };
